name: foreground-child-watchdog
note: FALSE POSITIVE from the 2026-07-19 MCP scan (xmcp@0.6.13). The `foreground-child` zombie-reaper pattern spawns `node -e <static watchdog>` that kills the child if the parent dies on SIGHUP — a fixed, inlined script with no attacker input, used by many CLIs. pkgxray reads the spawned `node -e` as a silent stage-2 executor. RETUNE DEFERRED (code-execution is a core detector; exempting the foreground-child watchdog needs a signature match on the static watchdog body, done per-case). Remove knownFalsePositive once code-execution recognizes the foreground-child pattern.
